title: The West Freezes Russia's Central Bank Reserves
dek: The US, EU, UK and allies lock up about $300 billion of the Bank of Russia's reserves and move to cut major Russian banks from SWIFT.
body: Russia lost access to about $300 billion of reserves. The EU now bars the return of about €210 billion of them.

panels.label: G7 Leaders Said
panels.text: Western leaders vowed to stop the Bank of Russia “deploying its international reserves in ways that undermine the impact of our sanctions.”

panels.label: Lavrov Said
panels.text: Sergei Lavrov said the West had “tossed out all their principles” and called the freeze “nothing but theft.”

panels.label: The Stakes
panels.text: Each side says it defends the rules; at stake is whether a state’s reserves held abroad stay its own once it goes to war.
